lines.sentence: Movement out of the corner of your eye immediately pulls your attention as what looks like a tree starts walking out of the forest.
No, not a tree, a person wearing nature as their skin. A beautiful nymph. Her voice is slow, but anxious.
Please help… These mortals are invading and ruining the forest. They set fire to my sisters’ and I’s home and then pushed us out.

choices.choiceText: Don’t worry, I'll handle them so you and your sisters can enjoy your home in peace.
I'm sure they will move on soon, give it some time.

lines.sentence: Finally some peace, thank you truly, you are always welcome here anytime.
I’m not sure how long my sister and I can wait while they desecrate our home…
